ambiguity.defect: Report DEFECT only when defect_when is satisfied.
ambiguity.clear: Report CLEAR only when clear_when is visibly satisfied.
ambiguity.review: If required evidence is unreadable or competing states cannot be distinguished, use NEEDS_REVIEW.

evidence.glare: Do not use brightness, reflection, or specular glare as defect evidence unless the defect rule explicitly requires it.
